Little Piggy.note: Main Coin and damage source (early-game it's only Red, late-game is every type)

Boar.note: Useless mutation tree. Only Gemmar and Mammoth might have an use

Hippo.note: Main mutation tree because of Rainboppo (Purple damage) and Chonkoppo (cheapest Pig to upgrade)

Horn Hippo.note: Good early-game for Realm EXP increase

Gemmar.note: Extra damage for your main Minion (situational?)

Mammoth.note: Extra damage for your main Minion (situational?)

Rainboppo.note: Provides Purple damage through banishing Minions

Chonkoppo.note: Main end-game Minion. Most expensive Pig to upgrade, which means more Coin generation

Pet Rock.note: Main source of Orange damage and Coin gain increase (early-game); and free Cornucopia rerrolls (end-game)

Mountain.note: Main mutation tree because of Orange damage, Volcano (Coin gain) and Everest (free Cornucopia rerrolls)

Asteroid.note: Useless mutation tree. Only Gasseon might have an use

Everest.note: Great late-game for free Cornucopia rerolls

Babby Egg.note: Main source of Yellow damage, Coin gain increase, Energy (early-game); and Orange damage, double-blessings, cashback, blessing rerolls and Enlightment Spirals (end-game)

Lil Chicken.note: Makes every Minion deal Yellow damage on critical hits

Goose.note: Early-game source of the best Coin gain increase trait

Phaser Duck.note: 2 of these grant a guaranteed double-blessing (hard cap)

Stork.note: Makes your Pig minions to also deal Orange damage

Crikeydile.note: 3 of these grant a 90% cashback (hard cap)

Purpback.note: Each one gives an extra blessing rerroll (up to Bagged Pancakes). Makes a really good combo with Musculor (Ogre Spawn family)

Blaken Gold.note: Each one gives extra Enlightment Spirals (up to Bagged Pancakes)

Ogre Spawn.note: Main source of White damage, Flowers, Coin gain increase, double-level up for Minions, chance to not spend blessing rerrolls, and double Food bundles (end-game)

Lizardman.note: End-game Blessing effect boost trait. This minion should fill every single slot once you have bought every other damage and utility Minions.

Scissarus.note: 4 of these give a guaranteed free extra level when leveling Minions (you pay one, and get another one for free!) (hard cap)

Retiarius.note: Used to have Boss Pilfer trait, now has Harvester: double Food bundles at Cornucopia

Musculor.note: 3 of these give a 90% chance to not use a blessing reroll (hard cap)

Corruptor.note: End-game Coin increase based on Trophies. Has high diminishing returns after 3 Minions of this type.

Big Bone.note: Deals White damage based on your outside-Realm damage

Torchy.note: Light all 4 torches in the [[Lord's Lair]].

Rare Shiny.note: Purchased with 575 Crystal Eyes. A reskinned Minion with an extra Trait.
